verified: Humyn Labs announced the $47 million round, split $26 million equity led by Accel and $21 million venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton, per the company's own statement reported by The Robot Report; co-founder Ishank Gupta described capture across vision, sound, touch and motion and partner operations in over 20 countries.
unconfirmed: the claim of more than $50 million in annualized revenue within six months of operations rests solely on the company's word, with no audited figures, and the report names no customers, lab partners, valuation or per-dataset pricing; the proposed Brazil, Korea and India build-out and any measured improvement in deployment cycles are stated plans, not demonstrated results.

verified: 据 Humyn Labs 公布、The Robot Report 报道，本轮4700万美元由2600万美元股权与2100万美元风险债构成，领投方分别为 Accel 和 Lighthouse Canton。
unconfirmed: 六个月做到5000万美元以上年化收入、20多国采集网络与四模态数据能力均为公司自述，未提供审计数字或第三方验证；客户名单、合同规模、单价以及跨机器人形态迁移的实际效果均未披露。

titles.en: Humyn Labs raises $47M Series A for real-world robotics data
titles.zh: Humyn Labs 融资4700万美元，为机器人采集真实世界数据
